title: Tung Tung Tung Sahur
blurb: TUNG TUNG TUNG TUNG TUNG SAHUR. The rhythm is borrowed from the Indonesian sahur tradition, where drummers walk the streets before dawn during Ramadan to wake people for the pre-fast meal. The internet took that centuries-old wake-up call, attached an AI-generated wooden creature to it, and installed the result on every For You page on Earth. The drum pattern was built to drag people out of sleep, so naturally it refuses to leave your head once it has got in there. One of the founding characters of the Italian brainrot universe.
origin: From Indonesian sahur drum-calling tradition; became a cornerstone Italian brainrot character.
